Bench: Jyotsna Rewal Dua IN THE HIGH COURT OF HIMACHAL PRADESH, SHIMLA Cr.MP(M) No.55 of 2024 Decided on:
16th March, 2024 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Amlesh Yadav alias Kamlesh .....Petitioner Versus State of Himachal Pradesh .....Respondent

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF HIMACHAL PRADESH, SHIMLA
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1 For the Petitioner: Mr. Sangram Singh Chandel and Mr. Prikshit Rathour, Advocates.

For the Respondent: Mr. Pranay Pratap Singh, Additional Advocate General with Mr. Sidharth Jalta,
Ms. Priyanka Chauhan and Ms. Archana Negi, Deputy Advocates General.
ASI Duni Chand, Police Station Nalagarh, District Solan, H.P., present in person alongwith record.

The petitioner seeks regular bail in FIR No.199/2021, dated 05.07.2021, registered under Sections 363, 365, 366A, 376, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 & 18 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 at Police Station Nalagarh, District Solan,
H.P.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Whether reporters of print and electronic media may be allowed to see the order?
2. The respondent has filed the status report and also produced the record.

After arguing for some time, learned counsel for .
the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the petition with liberty to move a fresh petition at an appropriate stage in accordance with law, in case need so arises.

Accordingly,
the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn with leave and liberty as aforesaid.
Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
